agreement_date.description: The date the agreement is made and entered into, as stated in the opening paragraph

name.description: The employer's legal name, as printed in the opening paragraph

principal_office_address.description: The employer's principal office address, as printed

position_title.description: The position the executive is employed in, such as Superintendent of Schools or Chief Executive Officer

term.description: The term of employment from the Term section

start_date.description: The date the employment term commences, as printed

end_date.description: The date the employment term ends, as printed

work_year.description: The executive's work year, such as '12 months, from July 1 to June 30'

compensation.description: Base pay and scheduled increases from the Compensation section

base_salary.description: The executive's annual base salary for the first year of the agreement, in dollars

base_salary_period.description: The year or period the base salary applies to, such as the 2025-2026 school year

pay_frequency.description: How salary is paid, such as twenty-six bi-weekly installments

annual_increase_percent.description: The percentage by which base salary increases each year of the agreement

longevity_payments.description: Longevity or retention payments, one per milestone

milestone.description: The service milestone or effective date that triggers the payment, as printed

benefits.description: Insurance and retirement benefits from the Benefits section

life_insurance_face_amount.description: The face amount of the life insurance policy the employer pays for, in dollars

health_insurance_employer_share_percent.description: The percentage of the executive's health plan cost the employer pays

dental_insurance_employer_share_percent.description: The percentage of the dental premium the employer pays

retiree_health_individual_percent.description: The percentage of an individual plan premium the employer pays in retirement

health_insurance_buyout_family.description: The annual payment for declining a family health plan, in dollars

max_retirement_contribution.description: The maximum employer non-elective contribution to the 403(b) or retirement plan on qualified retirement, as first stated, in dollars

leave.description: Paid leave entitlements from the Leaves of Absence section

sick_leave_days_per_year.description: Days of sick or family leave per year

bereavement_days_per_year.description: Days of bereavement leave per year

personal_leave_days_per_year.description: Days of personal leave per year

renewal_notice_deadline.description: The date by which the board or employer must say whether it will extend the agreement

resignation_notice_days.description: Days of written notice the executive must give to resign

governing_law.description: The jurisdiction whose law governs the agreement
